This book delves into the intricate and often challenging aspects of life, portraying characters who struggle with their existence, sometimes to the point of questioning whether to continue living. The narrative may feel dense, complex, and at times even confusing, reflecting the upside-down world these individuals inhabit. Their lives, devoid of stability and certainty, are marked by a constant battle with despair. The story captures the essence of their struggle, offering readers a glimpse into the profound difficulties they face.
